content.short: KriptoK is a non-custodial mobile wallet for Bitcoin, Solana and EVM chains.
content.description: KriptoK holds keys on the phone across Bitcoin, Solana and EVM networks including Hyperliquid, built around competitive trading. Traders take real perpetual positions, climb a live leaderboard and get paid for placing well, without keys ever leaving the device. A discovery feed surfaces trending tokens, tokenized stocks and new launches as they start moving. Swaps route across chains automatically to find the best execution.
content.meta: Mobile self-custody across Bitcoin, Solana and EVM chains, with a published Halborn audit.
